step1.title: Discovery
step1.desc: Browse any Steam game or featured collection in Discovery. Click a card to view details.

step2.title: Global Search
step2.desc: In Global Search, enter AppID, Steam store link, SteamDB link, or game name. Supports precise targeting and forced direct connection.

step3.title: One-Click Deploy
step3.desc: Click the Deploy button, wait for protocol injection to complete, then open Steam client to see the deployed resource in your library.

denuvo.title: D-Encrypt Games
denuvo.desc: Currently only D-Encrypt games with an existing voice38 patch are supported. Games without the patch cannot launch after deployment. Please wait for patch updates or switch to another resource.

movieGame.title: Movie Games / Online Auth
movieGame.desc: Most movie games have built-in online authentication and require a dedicated patch to launch. Direct deployment usually won't work. Please watch for patch updates.

onlineFix.title: Online Fix Patch
onlineFix.desc: Some online games require an onlinefix multiplayer patch to play online. Strongly recommended to test with an alt account to avoid restrictions on your main account.

multiplayer.warningDesc: Online launch only works for specific resources. Abuse may lead to Steam account restrictions or bans. Please strictly follow the rules below.
multiplayer.rule1: Do not use your main account for 480 multiplayer. Always use an alt account for testing.
multiplayer.rule2: Not all games support 480 multiplayer. Test and verify yourself.
multiplayer.rule3Prefix: 480 multiplayer only works with Steam friends using the same method.
multiplayer.rule4: Before each multiplayer session, make sure you have launched the game through this tool and the game files are fully installed.

unlock.title: How to Unlock DLC
unlock.desc: Only a few games support separate AppID search for DLC unlock. For most games, simply search and deploy the base game — the full DLC is already included. [Not guaranteed for all games]

missing.title: Missing DLC
missing.desc: Some games may be missing DLC. Please send a request via the sidebar, report the missing DLC and game, and we will update as soon as possible.

safety.title: Impact on Main Account
safety.desc: No impact at all. Whether using a dedicated DLC unlocker or deploying via library, unlocking DLC is completely safe for your main account — 10,000x safer than library injection.

download.title: How to Download Single-Player Games
download.desc: Built-in single-player games are tested: runnable, safe, and virus-free. Use TC's built-in download engine — no cloud drive needed, max out your bandwidth.

engine.title: How to Use the Download Engine
engine.desc: Built-in aria2c core, 16-thread concurrent, HTTP-only. Click + and paste the download link. Optimized for Nexus Mods direct links. Set your download folder first.

minigame.title: What Are Mini-Games For?
minigame.desc: Nothing serious. Play TC original mini-games to earn CORE points and redeem extra download quotas. As the author learns more skills, the games get better.

errNodeFail.q: All nodes are red, cannot connect
errNodeFail.a: Check local network connection, try switching to other nodes. If all three nodes are offline, wait for service recovery or contact support.

quotaExhausted.a: Daily deploy quota used up. Sponsor the developer for extra quota, or wait until 00:00 for auto reset.

engineDeployFail.a: Close antivirus and run this app as administrator. Ensure Steam install directory is not locked.

steamMissing.q: Steam install directory not found / path detection failed
steamMissing.a: Manually select Steam install directory in Settings (the folder containing steam.exe).

invalidEntry.q: Game not showing in Steam / deploy invalid
invalidEntry.a: Confirm you are only using one library tool. Multiple tools running simultaneously will conflict. If caused by network fluctuation, redeploy and restart Steam, or restart your local router.

noInternet.a: 99% network environment issue. TC has self-diagnostics and intelligent repair. Restart the app to auto-diagnose and fix.

gameWontStart.a: Usually because you deployed an unsupported resource type (D-Encrypt / movie game / online-only / third-party launcher like EA, Ubisoft). Wait for a patch or switch to another game.

launch54.a: Usually caused by ST engine or launcher Steam validation. Switch to OST engine, or use Steamless tool (search: steamless).

updateFail.q: Game won't update / version too old
updateFail.a: Usually because the game manifest version is locked. Redeploy the game with the latest TC version.
